entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to establish security between the UE and the network, including integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to initiate security mode control, specifying the security algorithms to be used.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to confirm successful activation of security mode.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to indicate failure of security mode activation.

entities.name: Selected integrity algorithm
entities.description: IE in SECURITY MODE COMMAND indicating the integrity protection algorithm to be used.

entities.name: Selected ciphering algorithm
entities.description: IE in SECURITY MODE COMMAND indicating the ciphering algorithm to be used.

entities.name: Security activation successful
entities.description: Condition where the UE successfully activates the security algorithms and sends SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.

entities.name: Security activation failed
entities.description: Condition where the UE fails to activate the security algorithms and sends SECURITY MODE REJECT.

relations.description: The security mode control procedure includes sending the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
The security mode control procedure includes receiving the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message upon successful activation.
The security mode control procedure includes receiving the SECURITY MODE REJECT message upon activation failure.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains the selected integrity algorithm IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains the selected ciphering algorithm IE.
Successful security activation triggers sending SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.
Failed security activation triggers sending SECURITY MODE REJECT.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND requires integrity protection for the selected integrity algorithm IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND requires integrity protection for the selected ciphering algorithm IE.
